passedFirst: what Claude says it read, and why, is one line of plain text (cc_claude_proposes) > every kind of line break and space is one space, in what it read and in a reason
Claude proposes through the mod, and only accept applies it (cc_claude_proposes) > a proposal lands as a checked change set beside the graph, with the graph and prose as they were
an answer’s JSON is read whether or not it is fenced, each change as a proposal takes it
a model’s reason is plain text: no Markdown in it can become an image, a link or HTML when notes are rendered
a note that carries instructions is sent as data, and steers nothing past the proposal > an answer that obeys the note is read as changes only: no key, no other field, and nothing applied
an answer comes back as a proposal (answers_are_proposals) > it is a proposal from the model, made against the graph as it was sent
asking an AI model to propose changes (§19) > a model’s reason is kept escaped in the note, and shown on the card as the plain text it gave
